name: County socioeconomic score
description: Income, education, health insurance and housing affordability per county (Census ACS), scored 0–100, with area-weighted state averages.

tables.label: US counties
tables.description: County polygons (Census 2017, 1:10m, via us-atlas): fips, name, county, state, state_fips, geometry.

tables.label: US states
tables.description: State and territory polygons (Census 2017, 1:10m, via us-atlas): fips, name, abbr, geometry.

tables.label: County income (ACS)
tables.description: Census ACS county estimates: median household and per-capita income, aggregate income, households and mean income, each with its margin of error (GEOID = county FIPS). Placeholder values (zero or below) mean not available.

tables.label: County education (ACS B15003)
tables.description: Census ACS table B15003, educational attainment of people 25 and over, per county: every attainment level as an estimate (_E) and margin of error (_M); GEOID = county FIPS.

tables.label: County health insurance (ACS B27010)
tables.description: Census ACS table B27010, health insurance coverage by age, per county: estimates (_E) and margins of error (_M); GEOID = county FIPS.

tables.label: County home value (ACS B25077, B25075)
tables.description: Census ACS tables B25077 (median home value) and B25075 (homes by value band), per county: estimates (_E) and margins of error (_M); GEOID = county FIPS. Placeholders like -666666666 mean not available.

tables.label: County rent (ACS B25064, B25063)
tables.description: Census ACS tables B25064 (median gross rent) and B25063 (rentals by rent band), per county: estimates (_E) and margins of error (_M); GEOID = county FIPS.

tables.label: ACS county columns (dictionary)
tables.description: What each ACS column in the county tables means: column, meaning, table and universe.
